messages:
rachel: Quick kickoff: legal cleared the v1->v2 deprecation. We need a lean migration playbook + prioritized fixes for customer-facing snippets. Target publish: Thu 16:00 UTC.
tom: I'll scan docs and samples for any /v1/ endpoints and hardcoded legacy model ids. Will output a path:line CSV.
priya: callout: mobile SDKs using positional payloads will break. Add migration examples showing explicit payload shape and a short note for Android/iOS.
leo: propose we ship two things: (A) a one-page migration checklist for customers, (B) a docs-only alias shim snippet for examples (explicitly flagged "temporary").
rachel: yes. checklist should include embed-dim verification, SDK upgrade table, and rollback steps for Dedicated.
tom: opened PR redwood/docs#6007 with script that finds v1 usage; results attached in PR. ci-bot: CI job "snippet-lint" started.
priya: I'll update the JS/TS and Python sample code to use the explicit request object { model:, input: } and remove positional examples. Will leave a shim sample labeled DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION.
leo: also add a small troubleshooting FAQ: "why are my embeddings length X vs Y" and console pointer to check model alias mapping.
rachel: owners: checklist (rachel), sample updates (priya), redirect map (leo), CI smoke matrix (tom). Please add owner tags in PRs.
ci-bot: snippet-lint failed on 4 files (two mobile examples, one tutorial, one sample app). tom: will triage and assign.
priya: patched mobile examples and tutorial; uplinked PR #6009.
rachel: once CI green, schedule publish Thur 16:00 UTC and coordinate email to integrators. Keep postmortem tag "deprecation-rollout" for any incidents.
leo: noted. small ask: ensure partner-facing playbook includes a short section about pinned weights and contact path for infra.
priya: added that. merging PRs now.
ci-bot: all checks passed. :white_check_mark:
rachel: thanks team. Short and focused rollouts work best.
